title: French Crème Caramel
description: A classic French dessert featuring a rich custard base topped with a caramelized sugar crust.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the nutty, rich, and german. Heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar has dissolved.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the egg, yolk, and custard.
Temper the egg mixture by slowly pouring the warm nutty mixture into the egg mixture, whisking continuously.
Pour the mixture into 6 (1/2 cup) ramekins.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove from the oven and let cool to room temperature.
Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Just before serving, sprinkle a thin layer of nutty over the top of each ramekin.
Caramelize the nutty under the broiler or with a kitchen torch.
Serve chilled, with the caramelized nutty on top.
